result.schema: CREATE TABLE keys (digest BLOB PRIMARY KEY) WITHOUT ROWID

assumptions: Independent preregistered cohort seeds; no selection of cohorts or seed retries.
Centered error: no temporal/compositional drift or remaining model bias. This condition is unproved.
Doubling exposure approximately doubles effective event information; calendar and dependence can break this approximation.
Per-fold Normal approximation for aggregate forecast-minus-actual ratio; effective information for fitted category shrinkage may differ.
Three fold outcomes can be dependent; union/Frechet bounds use marginal approximations, never a product.
Mean information across calendar folds is an illustrative scenario, not an independent-seed estimator; minimum observed one-seed information is a conservative scenario, not a population lower bound.
result.formula: SE(relative bias) approximately sqrt(1/(K*2*I_validation)+1/(K*2*I_holdout)); both calibration and evaluation variance retained

inputs.source: Previously reported v11 effective event information from fresh_data_audit; rounded four-decimal summaries, no new source or holdout access

interpretation.fixed_64_plan: Defensible operational compromise with declared power uncertainty; preregister all seeds, include every cohort, keep point gates unchanged and report not_ready if any required segment fails.
interpretation.no_adaptive_sample_size: After final exposure, do not add or replace seeds to chase a pass under this plan.
interpretation.not_covered: The calculation covers only zero-volume normalized-bias gates; other bias, MSE, MAE, interval and eligibility gates are not assigned pass probabilities.

limitations: Inventory covers the explicitly listed retained roots and AI04 lineage documents; it does not claim a machine-wide search of unrelated projects or deleted files.
All historical identities are conservatively excluded regardless of whether a specific holdout was scored. Hidden staging directories are excluded; the completed development snapshot is included.
Historical documents were searched only for immutable identity strings and locators; published score values were not analyzed.
result.scope: Read-only historical AI04 source/snapshot identity inventory from manifest JSON and documented retained lineage; no label, prediction, generated metric, or data payload files opened; no source generation. Lineage documents were scanned for identity strings and locators only.

qualification_warning: Calibration results are development evidence. Preserve all regressions; do not tune on future qualification holdouts or enlarge the sample after exposure.
